paper_title: Properties of Ultralight Bosons from Spins of Heavy Quasars via Superradiance
coupling_convention: f_a in GeV (upper bound on axion decay constant vs mass mu in eV)
notes: Paper derives black-hole superradiance constraints from heavy quasar (AGN) spins inferred via the Spin-Modified Fundamental Plane. Main particle-physics result on the f_a-mu plane (Figure 6): upper bounds on the axion decay constant (lower bounds on self-interaction) over mu ~ 1e-21 to 1e-16 eV, spanning f_a ~ 1e13-1e18 GeV. No explicit numerical table is provided; the data points above are approximate values read/reconstructed from Figure 6 and the scaling f/Mp ~ 1e-4 (1e-13 eV/mu)^{1/2} in eq. (4.5), so they carry O(few) uncertainty. Assuming negligible self-interactions, the excluded boson mass ranges are 2.9e-21 - 1.7e-17 eV (scalars), 6.4e-22 - 1.7e-17 eV (vectors), 2.6e-23 - 1.7e-17 eV (spin-2). Not a DM haloscope; no local DM density assumed.
